parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports the door and control panel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, protection, and housing for internal components such as the magnetron and wiring.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door is made of tempered glass with a metal frame, allowing users to view the food while it cooks.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a shield to contain microwaves and provides access to the cooking chamber when opened.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a hinge, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of durable plastic and contains buttons and a display for user input.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to set cooking time, power level, and other functions.
parts.Movement_description: The control buttons move slightly when pressed, while the panel itself remains fixed.
